properties.name: MEASURED at first run: 183 of 209 fixes are joined to no cause, 45 open defects were overtaken by a dated repair (65 by a change of any kind) — and the mirror as specified would NOT have caught the case it was written from
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-06 on reflow2's own export (3,794 nodes) with the shipped definitions, read back from the served surface before merge.

═══ fix_without_recorded_cause ═══
209 ChangeEvents carry change_type defect_fix (102) or test_failure_fix (107). Under the tight definition — the event sits on no CAUSES edge in either direction and carries no outgoing INVALIDATES — 183 are joined to no cause: 99 dated (82 in 2026-08, 9 in 2026-07, 8 in 2026-09) and 84 undated. A looser definition that also accepted a CAUSES edge on any artifact the fix CHANGED gave 150; the difference (33) is fixes whitewashed by an old cause on a hub artifact, which is why the loose reading was rejected. NONE are parked, so the aggregate reads '183 of 209' on the day it ships. That is the backlog rule:an-issue-is-root-caused-then-pinned-by-a-test-then-fixed (2026-08-26) predates for most of them; whether to park it forward-only is Anthony's ruling, not taken here.

═══ defect_overtaken_by_change ═══
234 TemporalFacts carry fact_type=defect; 199 are open (no valid_to, no incoming INVALIDATES). Over later dated changes OF ANY KIND on the subject (or an Artifact REALIZING it), 65 fire, and the served surface showed one hub subject (cmp:service) carrying 39 members — a question nobody can answer, and the wallpaper shape this project has killed three times. Restricted to later REPAIRS (change_type defect_fix or test_failure_fix), 45 fire (22 on Components, 23 on Capabilities), largest 15 members, median 3. That is the shipped definition. 29 more open defect facts have ONLY undated changes on the subject and cannot be ordered; 79 carry no valid_from at all and are skipped. So the detector reaches 45 of a population whose true size is somewhere between 45 and 173, and the bound is dates nobody wrote.

═══ ⭐ THE REFUTATION ═══
fact:a-defect-fixed-but-never-closed-on-the-record-was-re-fixed-wrongly-a-day-later says 'that detector would have flagged this fact on the day the fix landed'. Checked against the actual shape: the misread fact's subject_id was art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-04 — the DOCUMENT THAT REPORTED the defect, not the part that was wrong — and its real fixer chg:the-surface-says-what-it-already-knew CHANGED art:detect and seven other artifacts, none of them the subject or a realizer of it, and carried no detected_at. Under the specification as ruled, the mirror would have been silent on its own motivating case, twice over. The spec is kept (a hop from a report document to the code it describes is a search by words, not by structure); the claim on the origin fact is closed with this bound. What WOULD have caught it: the fixer drawing INVALIDATES at the time — which is exactly what fix_without_recorded_cause now asks of every fix.

BOUNDS: one export, one day; the 45 are not triaged (which of them were fixed is the question the gaps now ask); the aggregate count will move only when fixes are joined to causes or parked.
